summary: Tested VitaTracker Modules 16-20 (Gamification + Community + Professional PDF sharing). Backend: 14/16 pytest cases pass. Two failures point to a routing bug: the public HTML report endpoint '/report/{token}' is defined at the FastAPI root (outside '/api'), but the K8s ingress only forwards '/api/*' to the backend on port 8001. Non-'/api' paths (including '/report/…') resolve to the Expo web SPA, so any 'share_url' returned by POST /api/professionals/share (e.g. /report/abcd) is unreachable via the public preview domain. The endpoint works when hit directly on localhost:8001. Frontend (Expo mobile web preview): login (ana@example.com/secret123) works, and all requested testIDs are present and functional — home-gami-cta / home-community-cta / home-share-cta, gami-tab-Conquistas / gami-tab-Ranking (ranking shows 'Você está em #1 de 5 usuários'), community-filter-* chips, community composer + like + comment flows, and professional-share (4 PDF cards + create link modal + copy button). Minor React Native deprecation warnings observed (shadow* style props, pointerEvents prop) but non-blocking.

critical.issue: Endpoint is registered on the root FastAPI app (no /api prefix). K8s ingress forwards only '/api/*' to backend:8001, so this URL resolves to the Expo web SPA (returns the frontend HTML) when accessed via the public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. This breaks the 'share_url' returned by POST /api/professionals/share for real recipients. Verified: works on http://localhost:8001/report/{token}, does NOT work on https://fitpro-ecosystem-1.preview.emergentagent.com/report/{token}. Fix: move to '/api/reports/public/{token}' and update share_url and any frontend openLink().

integration_issues.issue: Since backend '/report/{token}' is unreachable through the public domain, tapping 'abrir' on any share link will open the Expo app instead of the report. Depends on the backend fix above.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated style prop 'shadow*' used — warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Appears repeatedly on Home, Gamification, Community, Professional-Share screens.
Deprecated prop: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (observed on onboarding/home).

action_items: Move public HTML report route from '@app.get("/report/{token}")' to '@api.get("/reports/public/{token}")' (i.e. under /api). Update share_url in POST /api/professionals/share to return '/api/reports/public/{token}' (or ${EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL}/api/reports/public/{token}) and update frontend openLink() in professional-share.tsx accordingly.
Migrate 'shadow*' StyleSheet props to 'boxShadow' (react-native-web / RN 0.76+) across new screens (community.tsx, gamification.tsx, professional-share.tsx and any shared style files).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1600 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth, food, gamification, community, professionals) for maintainability (>700 line rule).
leaderboard() computes XP for every user on every request (O(N * per-user Mongo calls)); acceptable for demo, but add TODO for caching once user count grows.
public_report HTML interpolates user-controlled fields (name, email) directly into HTML without escaping — low risk since auth-scoped, but consider html.escape() for safety.
seed_data_creation: Login used existing seeded user ana@example.com. Test created and cleaned up a community post; created shares (nutritionist/personal/doctor) — one 'Dra. Marina' share is left in DB from the frontend flow (visible in screenshots). Not disruptive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent fixes the /report/{token} routing (move under /api), re-run backend tests test_public_report_html_nutritionist and test_public_report_doctor_has_sleep in /app/backend/tests/test_modules_16_20.py, and re-check share-open-{id} flow on /professional-share.
rca_of_issue: Root cause: FastAPI route '@app.get("/report/{token}")' is registered on the base app (not the '/api' APIRouter). The Kubernetes ingress in this preview environment routes '/api/*' to backend:8001 and everything else to Expo:3000. Therefore requests to https://<preview>/report/<token> land on the Expo web bundle and return the SPA HTML, not the report. Reproduction: 1) POST /api/professionals/share returns share_url=/report/<token>. 2) GET https://<preview>/report/<token> returns text starting with '<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en">…<title>VitaTracker</title>' (the Expo shell). 3) Same GET on http://localhost:8001/report/<token> returns the correct '<!doctype html><html lang="pt-BR">' report with 'Nutricionista' badge. Mitigation: relocate the route to any path starting with '/api' (e.g. '/api/reports/public/{token}') so ingress forwards it to backend.
